epic_text:
Epic: Notification System
As a user, I want to receive notifications for important events so that I stay informed.

AC1: In-app notification center
AC2: Email notifications for critical events
AC3: Push notifications (mobile)
AC4: Notification preferences per event type
AC5: Batch notifications (digest mode)
prd_text: Multi-channel notification system. Must support in-app, email, and push. Users can configure preferences per event type. Batch mode sends daily digest.
architecture_text: Event-driven: Kafka → Notification Service → Channel Adapters (Email/SMS/Push). Template engine for message formatting. Redis for notification queue.
